routing_warnings.description: The client proposes delegated management of Facebook advertising rather than restoration of access through the existing account.
The proposal to set up the other account concerns the alternate-account route; the existing-account failure is represented by the later, more concrete message 96.
The client accepts proceeding with setup of the alternate account.
The login and two-factor-authentication instructions concern onboarding the alternate account.
Adding the client's email and limiting the sister's involvement are attributes of alternate-account access; the campaign-management clause may also support REQ_FACEBOOK_AD_CAMPAIGN_MANAGEMENT.
The client independently requests ongoing Facebook Ads management rather than alternate-account setup.
The request to manage Facebook Ads primarily concerns campaign management, although it prompts target-specific setup details in the reply.
The client defers proceeding with Facebook Ads assistance and does not specifically identify alternate-account setup.
